# Section 030 Knowledge Check: Governance With Policy Engines And Admission Control

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Write a validate rule that rejects pods without resource limits in selected namespaces
- Switch a policy between Enforce and Audit and read the effect in a PolicyReport
- Write a mutate rule that adds a default label or securityContext field to matching pods
- Write a generate rule that creates a default-deny NetworkPolicy in every new namespace
- Read a Kyverno admission rejection and name the policy and rule that blocked it
- Exempt one workload from a rule with a PolicyException instead of weakening the policy
- Write a ConstraintTemplate with a Rego violation rule and the parameter schema for its constraint
- Create a Constraint that applies the template to selected kinds and namespaces with parameters
- Switch a Constraint between deny, dryrun and warn with enforcementAction
- Read the audit results in a Constraint's status and list existing violations
- Find the error in a ConstraintTemplate whose Rego does not compile from its status
- Write a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy with a CEL expression that limits Deployment replicas
- Bind it to selected namespaces with a ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding and choose Deny, Warn or Audit
- Pass a limit through a params resource instead of hard-coding it
- Choose between ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, Kyverno and Gatekeeper for a given rule and say why
